data.narrative:
Manifold Bio is a Series A-stage biotech company founded by Gleb Kuznetsov and Pierce Ogden that has raised $40M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 3 public Biotech & Health comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private-sector peers including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

A single valuation method is applicable to this analysis: Stage-Progression. Using the company's $40M total raised as a proxy for current post-money valuation, a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage advancement yields an implied valuation of $80M. The Peer-Median approach cannot be applied due to insufficient narrow-set matches—while 7 same-sector peers exist, only 1 falls within adjacent-stage criteria, below the minimum of 3 datapoints required for reliable benchmarking. Public-Comp Anchoring is similarly inapplicable because the target's revenue is not disclosed, preventing application of the sector's 6.2x median P/S multiple across the three public comparables.

The triangulated valuation range is $68M (low) to $92M (high), with a median of $80M. This narrow range reflects reliance on a single methodology and underscores the primary uncertainty: absence of revenue data and revenue-generating comparables limits the robustness of the analysis. Additional disclosure of pipeline stage, clinical progress, or burn rate would enable multi-method triangulation and reduce valuation bandwidth.
